item.title: Ava Decleve leads county trio in 1,600 at K-Bell Track and Field Classic | Local Roundup
item.description: Santa Cruz County had three runners turn in personal bests and post time-five finishes in the girls' 1,600-meter race at the 34-team K-Bell Track and Field Classic at Westmont High in Campbell on Saturday.

item.title: Aptos High grad Cecelia Specht lands recurring role on CBS soap ‘Beyond the Gates’
item.description: The Sentinel spoke with Santa Cruz County native Cecelia Specht, who is featured in CBS soap opera "Beyond the Gates."

item.title: Monterey Bay Economic Partnership awarded $464K grant for broadband access in tri-county region
item.description: The California Public Utilities Commission recently awarded the Monterey Bay Economic Partnership $463,644 for the three projects as part of grants from the California Advanced Services Fund Broadband Adoption Account to support 21 projects expanding digital literacy training and public broadband access in communities across the state.

item.title: Clarence Darrow in the redwoods | Ross Eric Gibson, Local History
item.description: "Clarence Darrow (1853-1938) was one of the greatest litigators of his age, a modern Daniel Webster, for it was Webster who made speeches of reasoning, pathos and sarcasm that enforced the principles of shared national identity, bound by constitutional law, over the nullification, secession and selective enslavement of private interests.," writes columnist Ross Eric Gibson.

item.title: Name Dropping | Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County raises funds during holiday drive
item.description: Second Harvest Food Bank Santa Cruz County raised the equivalent of 8,653,707 healthy meals during its Holiday Food & Fund Drive, surpassing the campaign’s goal of 5.5 million meals.

item.title: Big Ten MBB: Year 2 offers little hope for the West Coast quartet as losses and irrelevance mount
item.description: Year 2 in the conference did little to improve the on-court trajectories for the West Coast schools.

item.title: Photos | Santa Cruz Little League opens for 75th season
item.description: The Harvey West Park baseball diamond is filled with players and coaches as the bleachers packed with families and friends on Saturday as Santa Cruz Little League began its 75th season with Opening Day ceremonies. item.title: Unbeaten Cal State East Bay men’s basketball team makes history while winning CCAA tournament
item.description: The Pioneers (30-0) beat Cal Poly Humboldt to win their first CCAA tournament championship and earn the program's first berth into the NCAA Division II Tournament.

item.title: Warriors trio records double-doubles in loss to South Bay Lakers | NBA G League
item.description: Centers Charles Bassey and Marques Bolden, and forward Jacksen Moni all posted double-doubles, but the Santa Cruz Warriors lost 113-104 to the South Bay Lakers at KP Arena on Sunday night.
